messages:
sophie: Heads-upCustomer (bank) wants an air-gapped POC. Main asks: minimal USB-deliverable bundles, HSM-based signing integration, and ability to do emergency security-only fixes between scheduled upgrades. Also asked about SBOM provenance for audits.

marco: we can do a small-footprint bootstrap + signed bundle model. typical flow: initial full bundle (includes runtime + models), then signed delta bundles for runtime patches. model weight updates usually need full replace unless we adopt a model-slicing workflow.

priya: clarifying Qs: 1) do they need model updates during POC? 2) how many machines will be in the islanded environment? both affect whether we recommend monthly cumulative deltas or ad-hoc patches.

sophie: they said ~6 nodes, models stable for POC, but compliance team insists on a documented patch cadence and chain-of-custody.

raj: chain-of-custody we can support: every bundle has manifest + signer fingerprint + SHA256 checksums. we also embed sbom.json. we can redact builder identity on customer-facing artifacts if legal requires.

marco: HSM signing options: (A) customer holds signing keys in their HSM and signs bundles before they land on devices; devices have the customer public key in truststore. (B) customer provides HSM attestation to sign verification policy but we deliver signed patches and customer validates. recommend A for max isolation.

priya: edge case: if runtime ABI changes are required in a hotpatch, we must coordinate a short restart and mark that in the manifest. customer needs to schedule maintenance windows for those.

eng-bot: [auto] sample verify: redwood-offline apply --bundle /mnt/usb/patch.tgz --verify --truststore /etc/redwood/trust.pem

marco: build constraints: delta bundles are computed against a specific baseline bundle-id. we generate delta metadata referencing baseline checksum; if device baseline mismatches, apply will fail safe. important to document in SOW.

legal-bot: flagged: SBOM export for audits -> include component licenses + CVE tags. also need to confirm exportability of redwood internal build IDs (we can provide redacted).

raj: operationally: customer needs (1) a jumpbox to load bundles, (2) an admin to update truststore, (3) local time sync (NTP) for signature timestamps to validate.

priya: pricing note: we usually include emergency patching as a paid add-on. for POC we can cover 1 emergency patch + HSM integration test. production pricing: ad-hoc patches ($1.5k/patch) or retainer bundles (e.g., $12k/quarter for up to 8 patches + priority on-call).

sophie: i'll draft a 1-pager and SOW addendum: include POC scope (1 baseline bundle, 1 HSM sign-test, 1 emergency runtime patch), deliverables (manifest, sbom, verify runbook), and ops dependencies.

marco: I'll attach a short manifest example and note ABI-change flag semantics.

raj: I'll prepare a sample sbom.json with license fields and a redaction example.

priya: propose scheduling a 45-min technical call with their infra/security team. available slots Wed/Thu next week.

sophie: great. @marco @raj please drop artifacts in the shared drive and i'll link in the SOW. closing action items: SOW draft (sophie), manifest snippet (marco), sbom/redaction (raj), price options (priya).
